— Who We Are

The finishing touch for every project.

Established in 1997 and headquartered in Beirut, SINAR is built around a single discipline — interior fit-out and finishing. We take spaces from bare shell to handover, delivering cultural landmarks, transport hubs, universities and commercial interiors with an obsession for the detail that separates a good finish from a great one.

Vision

Mission
A team dedicated to exceptional customer service, from start to finish.
Objective
Large-scale application met with cost-effective, innovative materials.
— Capabilities

Eight trades, delivered in-house.

From shell-and-core to the refurbishment of commercial, retail and cinema spaces — every system is delivered by our own teams, so the standard never changes.
